authorizedBy: The approved 2026-09 production-readiness sprint delegates local implementation of account erasure for Project rooms and Task Discussion. This receipt authorizes local and CI rehearsal only; preview or production migration requires the separate target-bound release gates.
reviewedBy: Codex P04 implementation candidate; independent Astra migration and lifecycle review is required before preview application.
authorizationSource: P04/#19 integration lifecycle remediation and the existing hard-delete account policy.

migrations.risk: Rebuilds three conversation-source tables to allow content-free, identity-free erasure tombstones while retaining bystander replies. Foreign key checks, exact trigger restoration, and populated upgrade tests are mandatory.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable conversation and Task Discussion writes; retain acknowledged source rows and erasure tombstones. Do not reverse an accepted erasure or restore erased identity.
postconditions: nullable author and creator columns exist only for guarded erasure tombstones
ordinary writes cannot change author identity or restore erased content
all existing conversation and Task Discussion guards remain installed
existing row ids, sequence numbers, and bystander replies survive the table rebuild
integrity and foreign key checks pass
